name: sol-luna-deepseek-router
description: Sol-led native Luna/DeepSeek routing through a hidden loopback gateway, with explicit DSH compatibility, per-chat ownership, and writer leases.

interface.displayName: Sol 主控 · 原生 Luna/DeepSeek 峰谷分工
interface.shortDescription: Keep Sol in charge; route new work to native Luna or native DeepSeek by peak/valley schedule.
interface.longDescription: Keeps Sol and the current conversation intact while routing new coding tasks to native Luna at DeepSeek peak windows or to a native DeepSeek child at valley windows. The optional hidden loopback gateway preserves the shared openai provider, transparently relays GPT traffic, and adds the exact deepseek/deepseek-flash model without replacing the main model. DSH MCP tools and the read-only trace remain available as explicit legacy compatibility.
defaultPrompt: Route this task by DeepSeek peak pricing
